name: OmniDocBench
description: OmniDocBench is a benchmark for document content extraction featuring high-quality annotations across nine diverse document sources, including academic papers, textbooks, handwritten notes, and newspapers. It supports flexible, multi-level evaluations from end-to-end assessments to task-specific and attribute-based analyses using 19 layout categories and 15 attribute labels.
reputation: A new document-understanding benchmark that is gaining attention for its broad document diversity and fine-grained evaluation, but it is still early in adoption.
notes: Covers diverse document types with comprehensive annotations; supports multi-level evaluation including end-to-end and attribute-based analysis.
